data.description: A gated community offering a serene lifestyle with its lush greenery, picturesque lakes, and upscale amenities.

data.answer:
Part of Emirates Living, The Lakes, is designed to provide a perfect blend of nature and modernity, appealing to those who seek a peaceful environment away from the bustling city life. The Lakes have six sub-communities: Hattan, Deema, Maeen, Zulal, Forat, and Ghadeer.

The Lakes Dubai master plan also includes recreational facilities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, and dedicated play areas for children, all within a secure and well-maintained environment.

Properties in The Lakes Dubai include a variety of 3 to 7-bedroom villas and townhouses, available for sale and rent, showcasing contemporary architectural styles.  

These homes have spacious layouts, high-quality finishes, and panoramic views of the stunning surroundings. Moreover, these residences boast amenities such as maid’s quarters, and ample parking facilities, along with community features like children's play areas, landscaped gardens, and swimming pools.

The Lakes Dubai Properties for Sale

Interested in properties for sale in The Lakes? Nestled in the tranquil community of The Lakes, the villas offer luxurious living with modern amenities and stunning landscapes. For those interested in purchasing properties here, the prices vary by size and luxury. A 3-bedroom villa averages around AED 5.4 million. The price for a 4-bedroom villa ranges from AED 6 million to AED 15.6 million. Larger 5-bedroom villas are available for between AED 8.7 million and AED 35 million. Meanwhile, a 6-bedroom villa can be purchased within the price range of AED 16 million to AED 23 million, offering expansive living spaces and exclusive community benefits.

Rental Properties in The Lakes

Rental rates in The Lakes vary by property size, starting at AED 290,000 per annum for a 3-bedroom villa. For 4-bedroom villas, rentals begin at AED 400,000 annually. A 5-bedroom villa starts at approximately AED 513,000 per year, while 6-bedroom villas begin at AED 349,000 annually. The starting rent for 7-bedroom villas is AED 699,000 per year. Prospective tenants are encouraged to review previous rental transactions within The Lakes to ensure they make informed leasing decisions.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in The Lakes?

data.answer:
Life in The Lakes is characterized by serene waterfront settings and lush green landscapes that provide a peaceful escape from the city's hustle and bustle. This gated community is designed for family living, offering residents a tranquil environment with modern conveniences. It features community centers, jogging tracks, sports courts, and children's play areas, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. The social scene is vibrant, with various community events and activities that foster a close-knit community spirit.

Public Transportation in The Lakes

Public transportation options in The Lakes are convenient for residents. While the community itself is more accessible by car, it is well-serviced by several bus routes that connect to the nearby metro stations such as Dubai Internet City and Nakheel. These connections make it easy for residents to commute to different parts of Dubai without relying solely on private vehicles.

Supermarkets in The Lakes Community

The Lakes community is well-equipped with several supermarkets that cater to the daily needs of its residents. Major chains such as Spinneys and Choithrams are located within the community, providing a wide range of products from groceries to household items. Additionally, smaller convenience stores are strategically placed throughout the community, ensuring that essentials are always within easy reach.

Shopping Malls in and Near The Lakes Area

Shopping is convenient for residents of The Lakes, with several malls located nearby. The closest is the Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai’s largest shopping centers, which is just a short drive away. It offers a vast selection of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities, including a cinema and an indoor ski slope. 

Other nearby options include Dubai Marina Mall and Ibn Battuta Mall, both providing a variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment choices to suit all preferences.

Schools and Nurseries in The Lakes

The Lakes is an ideal community for families, offering access to several reputable schools and nurseries. Some of the top educational institutions in and near The Lakes include the Dubai British School, which provides a comprehensive British curriculum from primary to secondary levels. 
Moreover, the Emirates International School Meadows and Regent International School are both nearby, offering high-quality education with various curricular options. For younger children, there are numerous nurseries, such as Raffles Nursery and Jebel Ali Village Nursery, providing early childhood education in a safe and nurturing environment.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near The Lakes

The Lakes community is well-served by various places of worship to cater to different faiths. The closest mosque is the Al Samad Mosque, located within a short drive, providing a peaceful place for daily prayers and religious gatherings. 

For Christian residents, the nearest church is the Emirates Baptist Church International, approximately 15 minutes away by car. Hindu residents can visit the ShrinathJi Temple in Jebel Ali, about a 25-minute drive. These places of worship ensure that residents of all faiths have access to spiritual support and community.

Clinics and Hospitals Near The Lakes Community

Healthcare facilities are easily accessible from The Lakes, ensuring that residents receive prompt medical attention when needed. The Mediclinic Meadows is the nearest clinic, offering a range of medical services and specialties. For more comprehensive healthcare needs, the Saudi German Hospital and Al Zahra Hospital are both within a 15-minute drive, providing advanced medical treatments and emergency services. These facilities are staffed with experienced professionals and equipped with state-of-the-art medical technology.

The Lakes Location & Nearby Areas

The Lakes community is strategically located to offer tranquility and connectivity. It is close to major highways, making it easy to reach various parts of Dubai. The Lakes community is surrounded by the other sub-districts of Emirates Living, like The Greens and Emirates Hills. Key nearby areas include the Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai, about 20 minutes from the area.

This prime location allows residents to enjoy the best of both worlds – a peaceful, family-friendly environment within easy reach of Dubai’s vibrant city life and amenities.

more_info.question: Things to Do in The Lakes

data.answer:
The Lakes offers a variety of activities for residents to enjoy. The community is home to several parks and green spaces perfect for picnics, jogging, and family outings. Sports enthusiasts can take advantage of the tennis courts, basketball courts, and swimming pools available within the community. 

For those who enjoy water activities, the lakes provide a serene setting for paddle boating and other recreational water sports. Additionally, the nearby Lakes Club offers a fitness center, dining options, and social events that cater to the whole family.

Restaurants in The Lakes

Dining options in The Lakes are diverse, catering to a range of tastes and preferences. The Lakes Club features several restaurants offering both local and international cuisines. 

Reform Social & Grill is a popular The Lakes Dubai restaurant known for its British-inspired menu and charming outdoor seating area. For those who enjoy Italian cuisine, Carluccio's provides a delightful array of pastas, pizzas, and other Italian favorites. Also, the nearby Meadows Village offers even more dining choices, ensuring residents have plenty of options for eating out.

Beaches Near The Lakes

While The Lakes is an inland community, residents have easy access to some of Dubai’s best beaches. Jumeirah Beach and Kite Beach are both within a 20-minute drive, offering pristine sandy shores, clear waters, and a variety of beachside activities such as volleyball, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. These beaches are also lined with cafes and restaurants, providing the perfect setting for a relaxing day by the sea.

Hotels in The Lakes

While there are no hotels directly within The Lakes community, there are several high-quality accommodations nearby. The Address Montgomerie in Emirates Hills is a luxurious option, offering world-class amenities and stunning views of the golf course. Another nearby choice is the Bonnington Jumeirah Lakes Towers, which provides modern rooms and excellent service. Additionally, the Atlantis The Palm and the Ritz-Carlton Dubai are within a short drive, offering extravagant stays with top-notch facilities and beachfront access. These hotels ensure that visitors and residents have access to premier accommodation options close to The Lakes.

Attractions and Landmarks Near The Lakes Dubai

The Lakes Dubai is conveniently located near several major attractions and landmarks, offering residents and visitors plenty of options for entertainment and exploration. Notable nearby attractions include Dubai Marina, a vibrant waterfront destination featuring a stunning skyline, luxury yachts, and a wide array of dining and entertainment options, just a 10-minute drive from The Lakes. 

The Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai’s largest shopping malls, is approximately 15 minutes away by car, offering an extensive range of retail stores, dining outlets, and entertainment options, including the famous indoor ski slope, Ski Dubai. Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), a popular beachfront destination with a lively promenade, numerous restaurants, cafes, and shops, along with various water sports activities, is about a 15-minute drive from The Lakes.

Moreover, Dubai Hills Golf Club, an 18-hole championship golf course offering stunning views of the Dubai skyline and a challenging play experience, is located about 20 minutes from The Lakes.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

The Lakes community is well-equipped to support an active and healthy lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a variety of outdoor activities, including parks and green spaces perfect for jogging, walking, picnics, and family outings. The community also has sports facilities such as tennis courts, basketball courts, and swimming pools for residents who enjoy sports and fitness activities. 

The lakes within the community provide opportunities for paddle boating and other recreational water sports. For personal care and wellness, The Lakes offers several high-quality salons such as The Lakes Club Salon and Tips and Toes, providing a range of beauty and grooming services. Fitness enthusiasts can work out at The Lakes Club gym, which is equipped with modern exercise equipment and offers various fitness classes. Additionally, the nearby Fit Republik and Fitness First gyms provide extensive facilities and training programs.

While The Lakes is a highly desirable community, there are a few considerations for potential residents. One key factor is transportation. Although the community is well-connected by road, public transportation options are limited within The Lakes itself. Residents may find it more convenient to own a car for easier access to other parts of Dubai.

What types of properties are available in The Lakes?

The Lakes offers a range of residential properties, including 3 to 7-bedroom villas and townhouses. These properties are designed with contemporary architectural styles and come with various amenities such as spacious rooms, maid’s quarters, and parking facilities. The community also provides shared facilities like children’s play areas, landscaped gardens, and swimming pools.

What are the average rental prices for villas in The Lakes?

Rental prices in The Lakes vary depending on the size and type of property. For a 3-bedroom villa, the average rent is around AED 290,000 per annum. 4-bedroom villas typically rent for between AED 400,000 and AED 530,000 annually, while 5-bedroom villas have an average rental price of AED 513,000 per year. Renting a 6-bedroom villa costs between AED 349,000 and AED 825,000 annually, and 7-bedroom villas start at AED 699,000 per year.

What amenities and facilities are available in The Lakes community?

The Lakes community offers a variety of amenities and facilities to enhance residents' quality of life. These include parks and green spaces, sports facilities such as tennis courts and basketball courts, swimming pools, and fitness centers. The Lakes Club provides additional amenities such as dining options, a gym, and spaces for community events. There are also high-quality salons and convenience stores within the community.

How is the connectivity and transportation in The Lakes?

The Lakes is well-connected by major highways, making it easy for residents to access different parts of Dubai. While public transportation options within the community are limited, several bus routes connect The Lakes to nearby metro stations like Dubai Internet City and Nakheel. Due to the community's layout, owning a car is often more convenient for commuting and accessing amenities in other parts of the city.

Are there good schools and nurseries near The Lakes?

Yes, The Lakes is an ideal community for families, offering access to several reputable schools and nurseries. Nearby educational institutions include Dubai British School, Emirates International School Meadows, and Regent International School, all providing high-quality education from primary to secondary levels. For younger children, nurseries such as Raffles Nursery and Jebel Ali Village Nursery are located close to the community, offering early childhood education in a safe and nurturing environment.

What happened to Fitness First Emirates Living Community Lakes?

The Lakes gym, Fitness First, is permanently closed.

The Lakes Dubai is an idyllic residential community that offers a serene lifestyle. It is set against the backdrop of picturesque water bodies and lush green landscapes.

The properties in Lake Dubai range from luxurious villas to contemporary apartments, each designed with attention to detail and equipped with modern amenities.

The community is well-connected to major highways, providing easy access to the city’s top attractions, business hubs, and entertainment districts.
